title: 聖蹄祭の、密やかな苦悩

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Trainer! Greetings, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Solefall Faire has come again, and this year's centerpiece is the Umamusume Cafe. With a long line of customers eagerly waiting outside the doors, all appears well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this wasn't the case a few hours earlier, where a portentous mood filled the student council office…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've found a store in the city that sells butler costumes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But the earliest time they can deliver them is midday. It won't make it in time for opening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Understood. I appreciate your swift handling of this. Midday… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. It's my fault for not paying closer attention…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is but a mishap—nothing to take personally. No one could've predicted our box of costumes would be collected with the garbage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still… we need to find a solution. We can't sell the idea of a butler cafe with no uniforms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We've run out of time though. We'll have to cut the morning service…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence envelops the office. Until…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! What an unforeseen predicament to have befallen you, good friends!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But my dashing looks will hardly lose their luster from the absence of a costume! It is an irrelevance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am who the visitors are after!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Please, you can't cancel the cafe! Everyone's looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I am who the visitors are after," you say…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, I might have an idea! How about this?

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text: I had my doubts when I heard the concept was changing to give customers a taste of what it's like to be a trainer…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please, enjoy this aromatic blend before you take to your desk, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry to disturb you while you eat. But what should we work on today?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, you've seen all my races?! That's dedication! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean! Um… Of course you came to all my races. You're my trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You want a photo? You need not even ask! A shame it would be if my beautiful visage were not recorded for posterity!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us go and find a window flooded in the sun's radiance!

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text: But this works really well!

text_block_list.name: Guest B
text_block_list.text: And the butler cafe hasn't been shelved. That's going to start in the afternoon! I've got to come again!

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text: Wait, but aren't all the spots booked already?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Don't you worry! We've made sure to add additional seating, so there's still spots available. Would you like to make a reservation?

text_block_list.name: Guest A
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll be waiting for you this afternoon. The next time you see me, I'll be in proper butler attire!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …I hope you'll be delighted, my lady.

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa!
